adversarial_framing_check_finding: General/Macro Press sweep surfaced Saudi Arabia in geopolitical/security contexts (Red Sea/Houthi oil-logistics disruption; US-Saudi nuclear deal; Iran's 28 Aug cooperation offer). Checked framing of the in-window Iran-Saudi cooperation story across Bloomberg, Iran Front Page and other outlets; the in-window regional-security news was de-escalatory rather than casting Saudi Arabia as aggressor, so it produced no distinct in-window adversarial-framing Negative Articles item. The dominant adversarial/reputational Saudi geopolitical coverage (Houthi blockade, airstrikes on Iraqi militias) fell outside the 24h window (21-26 Aug).
